description:
Shipless Factions + 26 portraits

aka "More Baddies" by dumbaq

Download Shipless Factions v1.01

mod-addon for

Nexerelin v0.10.4c

. Works with

Random Core worlds

enabled

Short:

TWO NEW FACTIONS WITH NO NEW SHIPS. ALSO 26 NEW THEMED PORTRAITS!

Longer:

So, ahem. At first i've been making this mod to tweak my own powerplay in sector. But if you ever happen to play your epic Nexerelin setup and just when the things were getting interesting the "

Hegemony/TriTachyon Diplomatic Victory

" window popped up, then I think you'll like this mod too.

Ofc the best solution to this Diplomatic-Victory-Problem is to download more custom-made factions and plunge the Core Sector into an endless war, but i personally do not enjoy all those fancy pew-pewery ships and weapons that every custom-made-faction-mod includes. I just want to play my old-good vanilla Starsector with vanilla hulls. But with some extras.

Features:

-

Two

(for now) almost-lore-friendly factions:

1. Anti-Hegemony Guerrilla

- The military group of deserters and terrorists, seeking justice and revenge on The Hegemony.

2. Valhalla Wolves

- Feral faction that splintered from TriTachyon, which unites former enforcers, fugitive corporats and laid-off clerks into one ferocious swarm.

-

Zero

custom hulls.

-

Zero

custom fighter wings.

-

Zero

custom weapons.

-

Zero

custom subsystems.

-

Pack of

26

vanilla-styled portraits (photoshop madskillz)

More info:

Those factions are designed to counteract major powers of the main sector, and they will almost never ally with its own counterpart. In this way they will totally prolongate your epic act of playing Nexerelin. Also they are

fun

and will diversify your powerplay in the starsector. You can join them and wreak havoc together.

While being a

Shipless

tm

Factions, they use

purely vanilla hulls, subsystems and armaments

to achieve their military goals.

AHGuerrilla is build mostly around mid-tech, they utilize a small number of worn heavy warships (including XIV) mixed with modified semi-pirate vessels and prefer ballistics and missle weaponry. Their officers are qualified and experienced. They establish hidden spacestations (just like pirates do) to terrorize core systems.Wolves are employing swarm of hi/mid-tech small ships in conjunction with significant amounts of fighter wings. They prefer to use blasters and lasers in combination with hi-tech missles. But anyway, their officers are former clerks, so their skills are quite low.

Also cool portraits!

Shipless Factions v1.0 (02-04-2022):

Added Anti-Hegemony Guerrilla fraction with 8 custom portraits and their banners.Added Valhalla Wolves fraction with 18 custom portraits and their banners.

aiDescription: Adds two new factions, Anti-Hegemony Guerrilla and Valhalla Wolves, designed to prolong gameplay in Nexerelin setups. These factions use purely vanilla hulls, subsystems, and armaments, ensuring no custom ships or weapons are included. The mod also includes a pack of 26 vanilla-styled portraits.
